title: Connection Reuse Ignores OAuth Bearer Token Mismatch

scenario.summary: OAuth / SSO Misconfiguration reported against curl.
preconditions: An OAuth/OIDC integration is in use with a configurable redirect_uri, state, or scope parameter

process.action: Capture the full OAuth authorization code/implicit flow in a proxy
process.expected_observation: Full sequence of authorize/token/callback requests recorded

process.action: Test redirect_uri validation for bypasses (subdomain, path suffix, open redirect chaining)
process.expected_observation: Authorization server accepts an attacker-controlled redirect_uri variant

process.action: Check whether the 'state' parameter is required and validated (CSRF protection for the OAuth flow)
process.expected_observation: Flow completes successfully with state omitted or reused

process.action: Test account-linking logic for identity confusion (linking by unverified email, no re-authentication)
process.expected_observation: Attacker links their OAuth identity to a victim account without proving ownership

impact: Authorization code/token theft leading to full account takeover
Cross-account linking allowing login as another user via a malicious OAuth identity
remediation: Strictly validate redirect_uri via exact allow-list match, not prefix/substring matching
Always require and validate a unique, unpredictable 'state' parameter
Require re-authentication or verified-email matching before linking external identities to an account
